what: CHORD RUN's chiptune sibling with an 80s arcade shooter that fires on every key you play: 11 game-style chord sets on the black keys (each its own level), a melody that follows the chord on the white keys, chip sounds, Game Boy style drums, a DRUM STUDIO with 20 user slots and an 8-bar chord looper.
author: swtdr34mz (based on Blop by Obsimo)
